up: Retrieve approved drugs (molecule_dictionary.therapeutic_flag = 1) where the mechanism action type is exactly 'MODULATOR' (drug_mechanism.action_type = 'MODULATOR'). Return columns: drug_name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), canonical_smiles (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), mechanism_of_action (drug_mechanism.mechanism_of_action), action_type (drug_mechanism.action_type), target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name), target_chembl_id (target_dictionary.chembl_id). Join drug_mechanism with molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, and target_dictionary. Do not apply row limits.
sql: SELECT md.pref_name AS drug_name, cs.canonical_smiles, dm.mechanism_of_action, dm.action_type, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid WHERE md.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND dm.action_type = 'MODULATOR'
